_comment: Sample C360_DATA for Piedmont Precision Components (Account 001bb00001DLtRMAA1, Package a5Fbb000000HA1NEAW, org bankinggpt). Every borrower.* figure below is shaped EXACTLY as the Customer360*.cls @InvocableMethod Response/wrapper classes return it (field names = the @InvocableVariable member names, which are the JSON keys the Salesforce-hosted MCP emits). Verified figures traced to SCHEMA-VERIFIED.md + HANDOVER-2026-07-01.md: TCE/TBE $12.5M, TOE/Outstanding $4.25M, rating 5, 3 facilities, 5 collateral pledges (80% advance, 1st lien, ~$10M lendable), 4 covenants all Compliant (DSC 1.42/1.25, Debt-to-Worth 2.18/3.0, Liquidity $8.2M/$5.0M, Fixed Asset Purchases $1.25M/$7.5M), Margaret Holloway 100% owner, 1 opportunity, revenue $64.5M, NAICS 332710 Manufacturing. Boom block is the LIVE payload (2026-09-03): boom_get_ratios raw for asOf 2025-12-31 under ratios.raw, and the boom_get_spread file (Piedmont_Precision_Components_Financials_FY2023-2025.xlsx, three annual periods, income statement + balance sheet + cash flow) verbatim under spread.file, minus the presigned downloadUrl, which is a short-lived S3 credential and is never staged. The display fields beside them (ratios.revenue/ebitda/ebitdaMargin/totalLeverage/interestCoverage, spread.periods/lineItems) are DERIVED from those two by client-360/render/boom-normalise.mjs and must not be hand-edited. Prior-year EBITDA is null on purpose: a Boom accountCode chart carries no D&A line, so EBITDA exists only for the ratios asOf year. Where a real value is not verifiable, the field is omitted/null so the template's gap state renders. portfolio.* is shaped as the VERBATIM Customer360Portfolio response (accounts[], bookTotals, signals, note — field names from Customer360Portfolio.cls @InvocableVariable members); bookTotals/utilizationPct computed over the sample subset; the Brightwater covenantsDueSoon row is sample-only like its account. NOTE: only the anchor Piedmont account carries verified figures; the three extra portfolio.accounts[] rows are SAMPLE-ONLY fictitious entries (each flagged _sample_only:true) for the L1 book view and must not be treated as real org data. They deliberately avoid the retired reference-mockup borrower names. UPDATED 2026-07-23 (Sonnet data/assembler agent, Cockpit v3 rebuild, SPEC.md §5): added the full `borrowers` map (4 bundles — anchor Piedmont duplicated from `borrower` verbatim, plus 3 invented-but-realistic C&I bundles: Brightwater Foods Group [COVENANT_BREACH — DSCR 1.05x vs 1.20x floor, both facilities under-collateralized], Sterling Fabrication Co. [MATURITY_NEAR — $8.0M term loan matures in 75 days], Kingsley Precision Works [MODIFICATION_CLUSTER/RECENTLY_MODIFIED — 2 facility mods in 45 days funding expansion]) and the `worklist` block (accountIds + reason codes). portfolio.signals.breachedCount and maturitiesSoon updated to reflect the new bundles. All three new bundles are SAMPLE-ONLY fictitious data, consistent with their pre-existing portfolio.accounts row figures (TCE/TBE/TOE/outstanding/rating/industry unchanged from the original sample rows). UPDATED 2026-07-23 (v1.1 amendments A9/A10): Brightwater's covenant retest date set to 2026-08-16 — an exact 45-day boundary case vs meta.generatedAt (2026-07-02T09:15:00Z) for the COVENANT_DUE ≤45d threshold; its worklist reasons now list both COVENANT_BREACH and COVENANT_DUE. Kingsley gained a 3rd modification (2026-04-08) so MODIFICATION_CLUSTER's ≥3-in-180d threshold is genuinely satisfied (previously only 2 were on file); RECENTLY_MODIFIED (≤30d) remains satisfied by the existing 2026-06-10 entry (22 days before generatedAt). UPDATED 2026-07-23 (Codex round 2 finding 7): every facility now carries an explicit `status` field ("Active" for all pre-existing ones). Kingsley gained a 4th, CLOSED facility — "Kingsley Original Equipment Term Loan", status "Paid Off", matured 2026-01-15 (in the past vs meta.generatedAt) — to prove the client-side active-facility filter (absent/"Active" = active; closed + past-maturity never fires MATURITY_NEAR). Excluded from exposure totals and from signals.maturityWatch. UPDATED 2026-07-25 (SPEC A30 + A29 seam): added optional `activity[]` (Sterling: REQUEST_RECEIVED + ANALYSIS_CONCLUDED; Piedmont: COVENANT_EVALUATED + ANALYSIS_CONCLUDED, both reusing figures already on file) and optional `requests[]` (Sterling only — ONE clearly-synthetic client request, revolver $10.0M -> $13.0M, reference.id prefixed SAMPLE- with no webLink per A29's honest-gap rule). Amounts sized against Sterling's REAL facility data (committed/outstanding/lendable-value), not the coordinator's placeholder figure, so validate-c360's data-quality sweep stays silent. UPDATED 2026-07-28 (coverage-correctness release): the Hartwell and Piedmont exposure blocks — and the legacy `borrower` anchor, which is the same Piedmont relationship — are now the VERBATIM observed Customer360Exposure responses from the bankinggpt org (accounts 001bb00001I7FPNAA3 / 001bb00001DLtRMAA1). `outstanding` is real (Principal_Balance-based); facility `totalLendableValue` now carries the facility's PLEDGED SHARE rather than the summed whole-collateral lendable, which double-counted every cross-pledged asset; new members totalPledgedValue, coverageNote, collateral[].amountPledged, collateral[].advanceRateSource and relationship-level coverageRatio / coverageShortfall / totalUniqueCollateralLendableValue / uniqueCollateralCount are carried through. The three SAMPLE-ONLY bundles (Brightwater/Sterling/Kingsley) are reshaped onto the same contract from their OWN existing figures — every ratio recomputed, nothing invented beyond the new members — and remain fictitious. Hartwell's bundle also carries collateralValuations, a SIDE READ and not part of any envelope above: Customer360Exposure returns no valuation fields at all, so the latest LLC_BI__Collateral_Valuation__c row per asset (CV name, date, basis, source, cycle, next revaluation due) is transcribed verbatim from the live REST read of 2026-09-02 recorded in knowledge/research/collateral-valuation-20260902.md section 5. No valuation FIGURE is carried, because the note states one only for COL-000764; the asset's own collateralValue is what the primary valuation left behind and is the only money the read prints. The block retires the day the exposure tool carries the fields itself. Piedmont and the three SAMPLE-ONLY bundles carry no such block and their assets read as no valuation on file.

meta.generatedAtNote: NOT the moment of a fetch. This snapshot was baked in two passes: the Piedmont anchor and the sample bundles on 2026-07-25T21:04:49Z, then the Hartwell bundle from a later org read whose newest activity entry is 2026-08-25T04:55:34Z. The original clock was left at the first pass, which put five Hartwell activity rows AFTER meta.generatedAt and failed the assembler's A10 assertion (activity and request timestamps are historical and must not postdate the deterministic snapshot clock), so the shipped book could not be assembled at all. A re-bake from the org is only possible from a session holding the Customer 360 connector (the fetch sequence in skills/credit-360-cockpit/SKILL.md); no repo script queries the org. So the clock was moved forward instead, to the LATEST OBSERVATION TIMESTAMP present anywhere in this file, computed over every historical instant it carries (activity[].ts, requests[].receivedAt, boom.spread.file createdAt): 2026-08-25T04:55:34Z, at borrowers["001bb00001I7FPNAA3"].activity[0].ts. Forward-looking scheduled dates (maturityDate, nextEvaluationDate, closeDate) run to 2036 and are deliberately EXCLUDED: they are compared against the clock as a window and are supposed to postdate it. meta.dateISO is left at the first pass on purpose; it is the report date behind validate-c360's stale-covenant heuristic, not the A10 clock. Replace both with a real fetch time on the next re-bake and drop this note. Set 2026-09-09.

portfolio.note: Rollups are package-level (Σ TCE/TBE/TOE/Outstanding — never a loan sum); risk rating + stage are from each account's highest-TCE package. Book totals span all 4 packaged accounts; the account list is truncated to the highest-TCE 4. Signals are bounded by a 90-day window and capped at 25 rows each; overdue covenants (past due, still active) are included and flagged. Financial / behavioral / risk-migration EWS lives elsewhere in the fleet.

exposure.note: Outstanding reads LLC_BI__Principal_Balance__c, the balance field this org populates (LLC_BI__AmountOutstanding__c is a fallback only). Available = committed - outstanding, floored at zero. Facility coverage divides the facility's PLEDGED SHARE (LLC_BI__Amount_Pledged__c), never the whole collateral's lendable value, which every pledge of a cross-pledged asset repeats. Relationship coverage divides the lendable value of the DISTINCT collateral, deduped by collateral id. Advance rate comes from one source, the pledge's LLC_BI__Advance_Rate__c (override, then auto-applied, then collateral type). Pledges flagged Excluded or Abundance-of-Caution are dropped from the math.

detail.verdict: Sterling is drawn to $9.7M against a $10.0M revolver (97% utilized, $0.3M available) and the borrowing base is already tight — pledged AR and inventory support $9.2M in lendable value against $9.7M outstanding (0.95x coverage).
